components.css: .ds-line { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr); position: relative; background: #1b2530; padding: 16px 0; } .ds-line::before, .ds-run { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 29px; height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; left: calc(100% / 14); right: calc(100% / 14); background: #3a4754; } .ds-run { background: #eef2f5; right: auto; } .ds-stn { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-stn i { width: 32px; height: 32px; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-stn i::after { content: ''; width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; border: 4px solid #eef2f5; background: #10161d; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-stn.done i::after { background: #eef2f5; } .ds-stn.now i::after { border-color: #ff5a1f; background: #ff5a1f; box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px rgba(255,90,31,.22); } .ds-stn.miss i::after { border-color: #ff8a7a; border-style: dashed; } .ds-stn.rest i::after { width: 10px; height: 10px; border: 0; background: #3a4754; } .ds-stn small { font: 600 13px/1 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .06em; color: #9aa7b3; } .ds-stn.now small { color: #ff5a1f; }

narrative.overview:
The week is a metro line on a dark enamel signboard. Training days are stations, the streak is how far the train has run, and each session's exercises are stops along a vertical branch. Everything is read the way wayfinding is read: from a distance, at a glance, by shape before colour. The world is dark only, chosen from the use scene (evening at home, phone propped on the floor 1–2 m away), not as a theme toggle.

Density is low and the scale contrast is extreme: one condensed numeral dominates each screen (the streak, the rep target, the rest countdown) and everything else steps far down to quiet UI text. Surfaces are flat enamel panels; depth comes from tone, not shadow. One line colour, signal orange, marks "you are here" and nothing else.

The system refuses the fitness-app card stack with progress rings: no tile grids of stats, no rings, no eyebrow labels over headings.
keyCharacteristics: Metro-line state grammar: solid ink = done, hollow ring = upcoming, orange = now, small track dot = rest, dashed miss ring = missed.
One orange, reserved for the current station, current exercise and the primary action.
Condensed tabular numerals carry every number; a humanist sans carries every word.
Stats are inline numeral+unit meta rows, never tiles.
Flat tonal panels on a near-black blue ground; dark only.

rules.name: The You-Are-Here Rule
rules.body: Orange appears only on the current station, the current exercise (pin, set bar, track node) and the primary action. If nothing on screen is "now" or "do this next", nothing is orange.

rules.name: The Ink Run Rule
rules.body: The ink run on the week line ends at the last done station's centre. It never extends to today or beyond.

rules.name: The Shape Before Colour Rule
rules.body: Every station state reads without colour: filled, hollow, dashed, small dot. Colour reinforces shape; it never carries state alone.

rules.name: The Numerals Are Signage Rule
rules.body: Every count, duration, kcal and rep is set in Barlow Condensed with tabular figures. Words never are.

rules.name: The One Giant Rule
rules.body: Each screen has at most one display-scale numeral; everything else is at least 2.5× smaller.

rules.name: The Enamel Rule
rules.body: Panels sit flat on the ground. No card shadows, no hard offsets, no glows beyond the current-station halo.

dos: **Do** keep orange to the current station, the current exercise and the single primary action.
**Do** encode state by shape first: solid ink done, hollow ring upcoming, small track dot rest, dashed miss ring missed.
**Do** end the ink run at the last done station.
**Do** set every number in Barlow Condensed 700 with tabular figures and pair it with a lowercase unit in the UI face.
**Do** show stats as inline numeral+unit meta rows.
**Do** pin the primary action full-width in the bottom dock at 60px tall.
**Do** keep tap targets at 44px or more (stops 56px, step buttons 72px) for use from the floor.
**Do** draw icons as inline 24px stroke SVG (2px, round caps) in currentColor.
donts: **Don't** add a light theme; the ground is dark by choice of use scene.
**Don't** place eyebrow or kicker labels above headings.
**Don't** build tile or card grids of stats, or progress rings.
**Don't** use orange for emphasis, highlights, celebration or decoration.
**Don't** add card shadows or hard offset shadows; depth is tonal.
**Don't** let colour alone carry a station or stop state.
